sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', e.event_date), 'YYYY-MM') AS mes, count(*) AS festas, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.status ILIKE '%cancel%') AS canceladas, round(avg(e.guest_count)) AS media_convidados FROM company_events e JOIN companies c ON c.id = e.company_id WHERE c.name ILIKE '%castelo%' AND e.event_date >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '12 months' AND e.event_date < date_trunc('month', now()) + interval '6 months' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
